# American Diabetes Association

> The American Diabetes Association (ADA) is the leading organization providing diabetes research, education, advocacy, and community support across all diabetes types.

Diabetes.org serves as the primary resource hub for diabetes patients, healthcare professionals, and the general public seeking comprehensive information on diabetes prevention, management, and complications. The site offers evidence-based education, risk assessment tools, and connections to clinical resources and support programs.

## Key Topics

- Type 1 Diabetes
- Type 2 Diabetes
- Prediabetes
- Gestational Diabetes
- Diabetes Prevention Program
- Blood Glucose Monitoring
- Insulin Pumps
- Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs)
- A1C Testing
- Diabetes Complications
- Risk Assessment
- Diabetes Management
- Lifestyle Changes
- Diabetes Education
- CDC-Recognized Prevention Programs

## Core Resources

- [Diabetes Research, Education, Advocacy | ADA](https://diabetes.org): ADA homepage offering diabetes research, education, advocacy and community services
- [Diabetes Professionals | American Diabetes Association](https://professional.diabetes.org): Premier resource for diabetes professionals with research, guidelines and career opportunities
- [Investigación, educación y defensa de la diabetes | ADA](https://diabetes.org/es): Spanish-language ADA homepage for diabetes research, education and advocacy
- [About Diabetes | ADA](https://diabetes.org/about-diabetes): Overview of diabetes types, warning signs, management tools and health resources

## Diabetes Types & Diagnosis

- [Understanding Type 1 Diabetes | ADA](https://diabetes.org/about-diabetes/type-1): Type 1 diabetes overview covering symptoms, insulin management and diagnosis
- [Understanding Type 2 Diabetes | ADA](https://diabetes.org/about-diabetes/type-2): Type 2 diabetes guide with symptoms, causes, detection and 60-second risk test
- [Prediabetes Education & Treatments: Steps to Prevent Type 2 Diabetes](https://diabetes.org/about-diabetes/prediabetes): Prediabetes education and CDC-recognized prevention programs to reduce type 2 risk
- [Gestational Diabetes-Causes & Treatment | ADA](https://diabetes.org/living-with-diabetes/pregnancy/gestational-diabetes): Gestational diabetes treatment, causes and health management during pregnancy
- [Diabetes Symptoms & Early Warning Signs: Know When to Take Action](https://diabetes.org/about-diabetes/warning-signs-symptoms): Guide to recognizing early diabetes signs including frequent urination and fatigue

## Prevention & Risk Assessment

- [60-Second Risk Test for Type 2 Diabetes| ADA](https://diabetes.org/diabetes-risk-test): Free online type 2 diabetes risk assessment tool with prevention program finder
- [Diabetes Prevention | ADA](https://diabetes.org/about-diabetes/diabetes-prevention): Diabetes prevention tools and resources including fitness tips and healthy recipes

## Management & Complications

- [Understanding A1C Test | ADA](https://diabetes.org/about-diabetes/a1c): A1C test guide covering blood sugar diagnosis, hemoglobin A1C and eAG conversion
- [Diabetes Devices & Technology | ADA](https://diabetes.org/about-diabetes/devices-technology): Comprehensive overview of diabetes technology including insulin pumps and CGMs
- [Lower Your Risk of Diabetes Complications | ADA](https://diabetes.org/about-diabetes/complications): Guide to preventing diabetes complications including heart, kidney and eye disease
- [Diabetes & Vaccinations | ADA](https://diabetes.org/about-diabetes/vaccinations): Vaccination guide for diabetes patients with recommended vaccines and resources

## Education & Reference

- [Learn More About Diabetes | ADA](https://diabetes.org/about-diabetes/more-about-diabetes): Comprehensive diabetes education on myths, genetics, nutrition and lifestyle
- [Know Your Facts About Diabetes | American Diabetes Association](https://diabetes.org/about-diabetes/diabetes-myths): Myth-busting guide clarifying diabetes facts and addressing common misconceptions
- [Diabetes Related Common Terms | ADA](https://diabetes.org/about-diabetes/common-terms): Diabetes glossary with medical terminology definitions adapted from NIDDK
- [Diabetes and Statistics | ADA](https://diabetes.org/about-diabetes/statistics): US diabetes statistics, epidemic data and state-by-state cost information

## Account & Support

- [My Account | American Diabetes Association](https://diabetes.org/constituent-center): Member account management portal for ADA services and constituent center
